name: When should I consider replacing my existing pool heater gas line?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my existing pool heater gas line?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing an existing pool heater gas line if it shows signs of corrosion, damage, or leaks, which can pose significant safety risks. An undersized line for a new, more powerful heater will also require replacement to ensure proper function and efficiency. Additionally, if you are upgrading your entire gas system or performing extensive landscaping, it might be an opportune time to replace older lines to meet current codes and prevent future issues. A professional inspection can determine if replacement is necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacement if the line is corroded, damaged, leaking, undersized for a new heater, or during major system upgrades for safety and efficiency.
